http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 import amqlQuery from modules::usage output application/json --- { query: amqlQuery(vars.ent.meter, vars.ent.measurement, vars.month.fromMs, vars.month.toMs) }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import sumMeasurement from modules::usage output application/java --- { meter_key: vars.ent.key, period: vars.month.period, usage_value: sumMeasurement(payload, vars.ent.measurement), collected_at: vars.window.at }

db:delete.doc:name: Delete month row
db:delete.db:sql: DELETE FROM usage_record WHERE meter_key = :meter_key AND period = :period

db:insert.doc:name: Insert month row
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO usage_record (meter_key, period, usage_value, collected_at) VALUES (:meter_key, :period, :usage_value, :collected_at)
INSERT INTO usage_snapshot (collected_at, period, meters_ok, meters_failed, errors) VALUES (:collected_at, :period, :ok, :failed, :errors)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import truncate from modules::util --- { collected_at: vars.window.at, period: vars.window.period, ok: vars.usageOk, failed: sizeOf(vars.usageErrors), errors: truncate(vars.usageErrors joinBy "\n", 4000) }]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.jobMessage default '') ++ ' usage: ' ++ vars.usageOk ++ ' meters ok, ' ++ sizeOf(vars.usageErrors) ++ ' failed;']

db:select.doc:name: Usage since contract start
db:select.db:sql: SELECT meter_key, period, usage_value FROM usage_record WHERE period >= :start

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys, nowIso from modules::util import computeStatuses from modules::usage output application/java --- computeStatuses( vars.entitlements, lowerKeys(vars.usageRows), (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM"}, p('alerts.warningPct') as Number, p('alerts.criticalPct') as Number, nowIso())

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert statuses
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO entitlement_status (meter_key, name, usage_model, usage_value, limit_value, unit, pct_used, status, sort_order, computed_at) VALUES (:meter_key, :name, :usage_model, :usage_value, :limit_value, :unit, :pct_used, :status, :sort_order, :computed_at)
